answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new framework for utilizing visual inputs in News Image Captioning... Since our work is also closely related to text summarization, we present more experiments on text summarization with BART.

answer_2.quote: To measure the overall quality of generated captions, we use BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, METEOR, also consider CIDEr as the most suitable one for the task.

answer_4.quote: We hire three graduate students with domain knowledge to rank 50 randomly sampled captions on correctness and fluency from 1 to 5, and pick their preferred caption.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated caption on correctness and fluency (scale 1‑5) and select the preferred caption.
